name: Lime Juice o Shiboru You ni
original_name: ライムジュースを搾るように
source:
In a time before airplanes, trains and cars, the world was a magical splendor of exploration by sea! 

One adventuring ship has sailed to the mythical land of giant women! 
Gulliver's Travels meets Attack of the 50 Foot Woman meets Japanese moe ecchi. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098799.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在飞机、火车和汽车出现之前的时代，海洋探索的世界充满了神奇的辉煌！

一艘冒险船驶向了巨人女性的神话之地！
《格列佛游记》遇上《五十英尺女人的进攻》遇上日本萌萌。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098799.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
